note: Generated by scripts/beginners-guide/build-glossary-hints.js from the Beginner's Guide glossary. Do not edit by hand.

terms.name: LP (Life Points)
terms.short: Your health: both players start at 8000, and 0 means you lose.

terms.name: GY (Graveyard)
terms.short: The discard pile, and a resource many cards use.

terms.name: Banish
terms.short: Removing a card from play, usually for good.

terms.name: Main Deck
terms.short: The 40 to 60 card pile you draw from.

terms.name: Extra Deck
terms.short: Up to 15 Fusion, Synchro, Xyz and Link Monsters you Summon directly.

terms.name: Side Deck / Siding
terms.short: Up to 15 cards you swap in between games of a match.

terms.name: Backrow
terms.short: Your Spell & Trap Zones, or the face-down cards in them.

terms.name: EMZ (Extra Monster Zone)
terms.short: The two shared middle zones where Link Monsters are Summoned.

terms.name: Normal Summon / Tribute Summon
terms.short: Your one free Summon from the hand each turn.

terms.name: Special Summon
terms.short: Any other Summon, from effects or the Extra Deck, with no limit per turn.

terms.name: Materials
terms.short: The monsters used up to Summon an Extra Deck monster.

terms.name: Tuner
terms.short: The kind of monster every Synchro Summon needs one of.

terms.name: Level, Rank & Link Rating
terms.short: The number that sizes a monster: Level, Rank (Xyz) or Link Rating.

terms.name: Token
terms.short: A stand-in monster made by an effect that vanishes when it leaves the field.

terms.name: Quick-Play Spell
terms.short: A fast Spell you can use in response, or on the opponent's turn once Set.

terms.name: Continuous Spell / Trap
terms.short: A Spell or Trap that stays on the field and keeps working.

terms.name: Counter Trap
terms.short: The fastest Trap: only another Counter Trap can respond to it.

terms.name: Field Spell
terms.short: A Spell played in the Field Zone; one per player.

terms.name: Equip Spell
terms.short: A Spell attached to one monster, usually to power it up.

terms.name: Flip effect
terms.short: An effect that activates when the monster is turned face-up.

terms.name: Chain / Chain Link
terms.short: A stack of activations that resolves last in, first out.

terms.name: Resolve
terms.short: The moment an effect actually happens.

terms.name: Negate
terms.short: Cancelling a card's activation, effect or Summon.

terms.name: Quick Effect
terms.short: A monster effect you can use during either player's turn.

terms.name: Trigger effect
terms.short: An effect that activates when something happens, like being Summoned.

terms.name: Ignition effect
terms.short: A monster effect you activate in your own Main Phase.

terms.name: Spell Speed
terms.short: The 1, 2 or 3 rating that decides what can respond to what.

terms.name: Hard once per turn (HOPT)
terms.short: An effect you can use once per turn across all your copies.

terms.name: Once per turn (soft OPT)
terms.short: Once per turn for each copy of the card.

terms.name: Target / Non-targeting
terms.short: Picking a specific card as you activate an effect.

terms.name: Lock / Summoning restriction
terms.short: A restriction a card puts on you for the rest of the turn.

terms.name: PSCT (Problem-Solving Card Text)
terms.short: Konami's standard wording for card text, where the punctuation matters.

terms.name: Missing the timing
terms.short: Why some old "When ... you can" effects fail to activate.

terms.name: Starter / One-card starter
terms.short: A card that starts your combo, ideally on its own.

terms.name: Extender
terms.short: A card that makes your combo bigger or keeps it going.

terms.name: Handtrap
terms.short: A card used from your hand on your opponent's turn to stop them.

terms.name: Board breaker
terms.short: A card that clears or gets around a finished board.

terms.name: Boss monster
terms.short: The big monster your deck is built to reach.

terms.name: Non-engine
terms.short: Cards that stop your opponent instead of making your plays.

terms.name: Searcher
terms.short: A card that adds another specific card from your Deck to your hand.

terms.name: Floater
terms.short: A monster that replaces itself when it leaves the field.

terms.name: Staple
terms.short: A card almost every deck plays.

terms.name: Generic
terms.short: A card any deck can use, not tied to an archetype.

terms.name: Tech / Tech card
terms.short: A card added to beat a specific deck or situation.

terms.name: Garnet
terms.short: A card your deck needs but you never want to draw.

terms.name: Brick / Bricking
terms.short: A hand, or a card, that can't do anything.

terms.name: Dead card
terms.short: A card that does nothing in the current situation.

terms.name: Beatstick / Beater
terms.short: A monster whose job is simply to attack hard.

terms.name: Vanilla
terms.short: A Normal Monster: no effect, just stats.

terms.name: Floodgate
terms.short: A card that shuts off a whole kind of play.

terms.name: Interruption / Disruption
terms.short: Anything that stops the opponent partway through their turn.

terms.name: Omni-negate
terms.short: An effect that can negate almost anything.

terms.name: Win condition (wincon)
terms.short: How a deck actually plans to win.

terms.name: Toolbox
terms.short: A deck that fetches a different answer for each situation.

terms.name: Search
terms.short: Adding a specific card from your Deck to your hand.

terms.name: Dump / Send
terms.short: Sending a card you choose from your Deck to the GY.

terms.name: Mill
terms.short: Sending cards from the top of your Deck to the GY.

terms.name: Tribute
terms.short: Sending your own monster to the GY for a Summon or a cost.

terms.name: Detach
terms.short: Removing a material from under an Xyz Monster.

terms.name: Pop
terms.short: Destroying a card.

terms.name: Nuke / Board wipe
terms.short: Destroying or removing everything on one or both sides.

terms.name: Bounce
terms.short: Returning a card from the field to the hand.

terms.name: Spin
terms.short: Returning a card from the field to the Deck.

terms.name: Revive / Reborn
terms.short: Special Summoning a monster from the GY.

terms.name: Recycle / Add back
terms.short: Getting a used card back from the GY or banishment.

terms.name: Excavate
terms.short: Revealing cards from the top of your Deck, usually to pick one.

terms.name: Crash
terms.short: Attacking into an equal or stronger monster on purpose.

terms.name: Burn
terms.short: Damage dealt by a card effect instead of an attack.

terms.name: Link climb
terms.short: Using Link Monsters as material for bigger Link Monsters.

terms.name: Rank-up
terms.short: Turning an Xyz Monster into a higher-Rank one.

terms.name: Combo / Line
terms.short: A string of effects played in one turn; one route through it is a "line".

terms.name: Going first / going second
terms.short: Who takes the first turn, and what each choice gives up.

terms.name: End board
terms.short: The cards left on your field when your turn ends.

terms.name: Choke point
terms.short: The one card or effect a combo can't do without.

terms.name: Bait
terms.short: Making a play just to draw out the opponent's answer.

terms.name: Play through
terms.short: Carrying on with your combo after an interruption.

terms.name: OTK / FTK
terms.short: Winning from 8000 LP in one turn, or on the very first turn.

terms.name: Lethal / Game
terms.short: Enough damage to win this turn.

terms.name: Card advantage (+1 / −1)
terms.short: Having more cards to work with than your opponent.

terms.name: Overextend
terms.short: Committing more cards to the field than you need to.

terms.name: Grind game
terms.short: A long game of trading cards over many turns.

terms.name: Combo, control & stun decks
terms.short: The three broad ways decks play: combo, control and stun.

terms.name: Topdeck
terms.short: The card you draw for the turn, especially when you need a specific one.

terms.name: Win-more
terms.short: A card that only helps when you're already winning.

terms.name: Power creep
terms.short: New cards gradually outclassing old ones.

terms.name: Mirror match
terms.short: Both players using the same deck.

terms.name: Deck out
terms.short: Losing because you must draw from an empty Deck.

terms.name: Archetype
terms.short: A family of cards with a shared name that work together.

terms.name: Meta
terms.short: The strongest, most-played decks right now.

terms.name: Tier 0 / 1 / 2 / Rogue
terms.short: An informal ranking of decks by tournament results.

terms.name: Netdeck
terms.short: Copying a decklist someone else published.

terms.name: Top / Top cut
terms.short: Reaching the final rounds of a tournament.

terms.name: TCG / OCG
terms.short: The two regional versions of the paper game.

terms.name: MD (Master Duel)
terms.short: Konami's official free online version of the game.

terms.name: Banlist (F&L list)
terms.short: The list of Forbidden, Limited and Semi-Limited cards.

terms.name: Locals
terms.short: Regular tournaments at your local game store.

terms.name: OTS
terms.short: A store that runs official Konami tournaments.

terms.name: Regionals, YCS & WCQ
terms.short: Large tournaments, up to the World Championship qualifiers.

terms.name: Structure Deck
terms.short: A pre-built, ready-to-play deck in one box.

terms.name: Singles
terms.short: Individual cards bought on their own.

terms.name: Sim (simulator)
terms.short: A free, unofficial program for playing online.
